next_step: Finalize baseline QPS & token/sec profiles; run 2-week POC on a 4-GPU dedicated pool; negotiate SLA credits and data residency language
notes:
Kickoff notes + workshop summary:
- Focus: enterprise Dedicated capacity for low-latency chat + high-volume reranking pipelines.
- Primary ask: predictable throughput guarantees (reserved GPU pool) and clear latency SLOs (p95/p99 targets).
- Baseline observed from pilot logs: steady-state chat ~85 QPS average, mean request tokens ~220 (prompt+resp), token/sec baseline ~18.7k. Peak observed during nightly batch reranking: bursts to ~420 QPS with heavy tokens (~1.2k tokens per request) -> peak token/sec ~504k (needs batching strategy).
- Customer quotes: "We cannot exceed 200ms p95 for short-turn chat flows; anything above impacts retention." and "Cost predictability is as important as latency — we need committed-reserve options."
- SLA discussions: wants 99.95% uptime for dedicated pool, financial credits for missed SLOs, deterministic failover to smaller model variant rather than complete failure.
- Security: strict data residency to us-west-2, KMS-managed keys, 7-year audit log retention ask (negotiable), SSO/SAML + SCIM.
- Ops preferences: autoscale + burst to 2x reserved capacity for 15 min windows; transparent token-level cost reporting; route-by-policy to fallback to smaller quantized model under heavy load.
- Workshop output (2025-02-20): suggested baseline reserved config = 4 H100-equivalent GPUs for steady-state chat workloads, with policy to burst to 8 GPUs for scheduled nightly reranking windows. Suggested batching & KV cache profiles to push effective tokens/sec per GPU up by ~2.5x for reranking.
- POC plan: 2-week dedicated cluster (4 GPUs) + Redwood Optimize tuning pass week 1, synthetic peak replay week 2. Success criteria: meet p95 <200ms for chat at steady-state QPS and <400ms for 95th at 2x steady burst, maintain cost within ARR estimate.
- Internal follow-ups: SE to supply detailed QPS-to-GPU projection spreadsheet; Security to start residency review; Finance to draft reserved pricing term sheet.
- Notes style: shorthand capture of calls and actions — refer to Drive deck for full calculations and to Fireflies transcripts for quotes.
